What a bite does

No clinical summary recorded yet.

Antivenom source. CSL taipan antivenom prevented the neurotoxic effects of its venom in the lab (Barber et al. 2014, Toxins 6(7):1979); no human bites recorded, so clinical efficacy is unconfirmed.

If you are bitten

Get to a hospital that holds antivenom. Keep still, remove rings and watches, and do not cut, suck or tie off the bite. Use the red “Bitten?” button at the top of any page.
